constitucion.title: Constitución Nacional de la República del Paraguay (20 de junio de 1992), con la enmienda N.° 1 de 2011, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
constitucion.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
constitucion.note: Official text with errata, pp. 7-111 of the compendium. Art. 118: universal, direct, secret suffrage and proportional representation; arts. 121-122: the legislative referendum; art. 156: departments, municipalities, and districts; art. 157: Asunción a municipality independent of every department; art. 161: a governor and a junta departamental elected in each department with the general elections for five years; art. 167: an intendente and a junta municipal elected directly; art. 187: senators and deputies elected with the President for five years from 1 July; art. 221: at least 80 deputies in departmental colleges, Asunción its own college; art. 223: at least 45 senators in one national constituency; arts. 229-230: President and Vice President on one ticket by simple majority for five years from 15 August, elections 90 to 120 days before the term ends; arts. 251, 262-264: judges named by the Supreme Court from the Consejo de la Magistratura's ternas, two of whose members are lawyers elected by their peers for three years; arts. 289-291: reform by an elected Convención Nacional Constituyente; art. 290: amendments put to a referendum; transitional arts. 3-4: the first general elections under it between 15 April and May 1993. Footnote 46 records enmienda N.° 1 of 17 October 2011 (voters abroad).

codigo.title: Ley N.° 834/96 Que establece el Código Electoral Paraguayo, con sus modificaciones, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
codigo.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
codigo.note: Pp. 167-267 of the compendium, with the amending laws. Art. 106 (Ley 3166/2007): one roll per electoral district for President, Senate, Chamber, Parlamentarios del Mercosur, governor, junta departamental, intendente, junta municipal, constituent conventioneers, and referendum; art. 107: each municipality an electoral district; art. 154 (Leyes 1830/2001, 1890/2002, 1975/2002): national elections in April or May, municipal elections in October or November thirty months after the general elections, party candidate selection 90-135 days (national) or 90-120 days (municipal) before, an election to fill a vacant vice presidency in the first three years, and elections after a governor or intendente is removed; art. 253: intendentes by simple majority for five years on a separate ballot; arts. 259-265: the legislative referendum (one national constituency, simple majority) and the constitutional referendum within 180 days of an amendment.

ley6318.title: Ley N.° 6318/19 Que modifica la Ley N.° 834/96 e incorpora el sistema de listas cerradas, desbloqueadas y de representación proporcional para cargos pluripersonales, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
ley6318.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
ley6318.note: Pp. 396-400 of the compendium. Rewrites arts. 241, 247, 249, 250, and 258 of the Code: constituent conventioneers, senators, deputies (in departmental colleges with Asunción its own), Parlamentarios del Mercosur, and members of the departmental and municipal juntas are elected from closed, unblocked lists by proportional representation, each voter marking one preferred candidate who reorders the list; governors by simple majority.

ley426.title: Ley N.° 426/94 Que establece la Carta Orgánica del Gobierno Departamental, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
ley426.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
ley426.note: Pp. 112-134 of the compendium. Art. 10: a governor and a junta departamental in each department, elected directly for five years with the general elections, the governor not re-eligible; art. 11 (as amended by art. 343 of Ley 834/96): 7 to 21 junta members by the department's roll, one more per 15,000 registered voters above 35,000.

ley3966.title: Ley N.° 3966/10 Orgánica Municipal, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
ley3966.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
ley3966.note: Pp. 272-377 of the compendium. Art. 22: juntas municipales elected directly; art. 24: 24 councillors in Asunción, 12 in departmental capitals and municipalities of the first and second groups, 9 in the third and fourth, with as many substitutes; arts. 57-60: Juntas Comunales de Vecinos in compañías, colonias, and barrios, created by the intendencia, whose authorities are elected under the intendencia's oversight; art. 65: Comisiones Vecinales recognised by the intendencia under municipal ordinances.

ley635.title: Ley N.° 635/95 Que reglamenta la Justicia Electoral, en Normativa Electoral Paraguaya, edición 2026
ley635.publisher: Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral (TSJE), Dirección de Legislación y Compilación
ley635.note: Pp. 135-161 of the compendium. The Justicia Electoral calls, runs, counts, and judges general, departmental, and municipal elections and popular consultations; it replaced the Junta Electoral Central.

classes.name: Referéndum
classes.name_en: Referendums: constitutional (on amendments) and legislative (called by law)
classes.note: A constitutional referendum follows every amendment the Congress passes (Constitution art. 290; Código art. 265); a legislative referendum, binding or consultative, is called by law at the request of the executive, five senators, or ten deputies, in one national constituency (arts. 121-122; Código arts. 259-262). The only one held is the referendum of 9 October 2011 on enmienda N.° 1 (voting by Paraguayans abroad), approved and promulgated on 17 October 2011.

access.format: csv, xlsx (per the portal's former listings; not reachable to confirm)
access.evidence: The 2011 referendum. The Tribunal's 2026 site serves only the 2026 municipal results, and its open data portal (datos.tsje.gov.py) refused this check.

dates.quote: Footnote 46 to art. 120: "Modificado por enmienda constitucional N.° 1, del 17/10/2011." Art. 290: the amendment is sent to the Tribunal "para que, dentro del plazo de ciento ochenta días, se convoque a un referéndum."

classes.name: Convención Nacional Constituyente
classes.name_en: National Constituent Convention
classes.disposition_reason: No official publication of the 1991 or earlier conventions' results is online: the Tribunal's site begins with 2026 and its open data portal refused this check; the 1991 election was run by the Junta Electoral Central before the Tribunal existed.
classes.note: Elected only to reform the Constitution, with no more members than the Congress, by proportional representation (Constitution arts. 289-291; Código art. 241). The convention elected on 1 December 1991 wrote the 1992 Constitution; earlier conventions wrote or amended the charters of 1870, 1967, and 1977. None has been elected since.

classes.name: Elección de abogados para el Consejo de la Magistratura
classes.name_en: Lawyers' election of their two members of the Council of the Magistracy
classes.disposition_reason: The Tribunal runs it and posts the 2026 calendar and roll, but no results of past lawyers' elections were found on its site, and its open data portal refused this check.
classes.note: Registered lawyers elect two of the Consejo's eight members by direct vote for three years (Constitution arts. 262-263); the Tribunal runs the election. The 2026-2029 election is on Saturday 28 November 2026. The two law professors on the Consejo are elected by their peers in the faculties (consejo_magistratura_profesores).

classes.name: Profesores de Derecho en el Consejo de la Magistratura
classes.name_en: Law professors elected by their peers to the Council of the Magistracy
classes.disposition_reason: Elected by the law faculty professors of the Universidad Nacional and of the private universities (Constitution art. 262), within the universities and not on the Tribunal's rolls; the Tribunal's 2026 calendar covers only the lawyers' election.

classes.name: Elecciones internas simultáneas de partidos, movimientos y concertaciones
classes.name_en: Parties' simultaneous internal elections choosing candidates and party authorities
classes.disposition_reason: Run, counted, and proclaimed by each party's own electoral tribunal (Reseña 2026, p. 94; Código art. 154); the Tribunal only lends machines, materials, delegates, and preliminary transmission, so it does not declare the results.

classes.name: Juntas Comunales de Vecinos y Comisiones Vecinales
classes.name_en: Neighborhood boards in compañías, colonias, and barrios
classes.disposition_reason: Auxiliary bodies the intendencia creates or recognises, whose authorities residents elect under the intendencia's oversight or under municipal ordinances (Ley 3966/10 arts. 57-60, 65); not run by the Tribunal and published by no official body.

classes.name: Ministros de la Corte Suprema, jueces y ministros del Tribunal Superior de Justicia Electoral
classes.name_en: Supreme Court and electoral court justices and judges
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed, not elected by voters: judges by the Supreme Court from the Consejo de la Magistratura's ternas (Constitution art. 251), and Supreme Court and electoral justices by the Senate with the executive's agreement from such ternas (arts. 264, 275).

classes.name: Designaciones del Congreso y de las juntas
classes.name_en: Officers chosen by other organs (Fiscal General, Defensor del Pueblo, Contralor, and the junta member who completes a governor's term)
classes.disposition_reason: Chosen by the executive with the Senate's agreement (Fiscal General, art. 269), by the Chamber of Deputies (Defensor del Pueblo, art. 277; Contralor, art. 281), or by the junta departamental from its members (a governor's vacancy, Código art. 154), not by voters.

classes.name: Intendentes designados por el Poder Ejecutivo
classes.name_en: Mayors appointed by the executive before 1991
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed by the executive under the 1967 Constitution and earlier, not elected; abolished by the 1990 electoral code and the 1992 Constitution (art. 167).

classes.name: Presidente de la República (constituciones de 1870, 1940 y 1967)
classes.name_en: President of the Republic under the 1870, 1940, and 1967 constitutions
classes.disposition_reason: No official publication of these results is online: the Tribunal, created in 1995, publishes none of the Junta Electoral Central's results on its site, and its open data portal refused this check.
classes.note: Chosen by electors under the 1870 Constitution and directly under those of 1940 and 1967, for five years; the last such election, on 1 May 1989, followed the 1989 coup.

classes.name: Congreso, Cámara de Representantes y Cámaras de Senadores y Diputados (1870-1992)
classes.name_en: The legislature under the 1870, 1940, and 1967 constitutions
classes.disposition_reason: No official publication of these results is online: the Tribunal, created in 1995, publishes none of the Junta Electoral Central's results on its site, and its open data portal refused this check.
classes.note: A bicameral Congress under the 1870 Constitution, a single Cámara de Representantes under the 1940 charter, and a Senate and Chamber under the 1967 Constitution, whose winning party took two thirds of the seats; transitional art. 3 of the 1992 Constitution kept the Congress elected in 1989 until 1993.
